query.query: SELECT DISTINCT board FROM posts_latest ORDER BY board
query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT board FROM posts_latest ORDER BY board

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(commented_at) AS time, board, count() AS `推文數`
FROM comments_latest FINAL
WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND $__timeFilter_ms(commented_at) AND board IN ($board)
GROUP BY time, board
ORDER BY time

SELECT
    p.board AS board,
    countIf(s.post_id != '' AND s.polarity = 'negative' AND s.score >= toFloat64OrDefault('$min_score', 0.5)) AS `負面`,
    countIf(s.post_id != '' AND s.polarity = 'neutral' AND s.score >= toFloat64OrDefault('$min_score', 0.5)) AS `中立`,
    countIf(s.post_id != '' AND s.polarity = 'positive' AND s.score >= toFloat64OrDefault('$min_score', 0.5)) AS `正面`,
    countIf(s.post_id != '' AND s.score < toFloat64OrDefault('$min_score', 0.5)) AS `不確定`,
    countIf(s.post_id = '') AS `尚無`
FROM posts_latest AS p FINAL
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM post_sentiment_latest WHERE post_id IN (SELECT post_id FROM posts_latest WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(created_at) AND board IN ($board))) AS s ON p.post_id = s.post_id
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(p.created_at) AND p.board IN ($board)
GROUP BY p.board
ORDER BY p.board

SELECT
    toStartOfDay(toTimeZone(p.created_at, 'Asia/Taipei')) AS time,
    countIf(s.polarity = 'negative') / count() AS `負面`,
    countIf(s.polarity = 'neutral') / count() AS `中立`,
    countIf(s.polarity = 'positive') / count() AS `正面`
FROM posts_latest AS p FINAL
INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM post_sentiment_latest WHERE post_id IN (SELECT post_id FROM posts_latest WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(created_at) AND board IN ($board))) AS s ON p.post_id = s.post_id
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(p.created_at) AND p.board IN ($board)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
    p.board AS `看板`,
    ifNull(p.title, '') AS `標題`,
    v.push AS `推`,
    v.boo AS `噓`,
    round(v.boo / (v.push + v.boo), 2) AS `爭議度`,
    if(startsWith(p.url, 'https://www.ptt.cc/'), p.url, '') AS url
FROM posts_latest AS p FINAL
INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM post_votes WHERE post_id IN (SELECT post_id FROM posts_latest WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(created_at) AND board IN ($board))) AS v ON p.post_id = v.post_id
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(p.created_at) AND p.board IN ($board) AND v.push + v.boo >= 10
ORDER BY v.boo / (v.push + v.boo) DESC, p.post_id
LIMIT 20

SELECT
    h.board AS `看板`,
    if(p.post_id = '', h.post_id, ifNull(p.title, '')) AS `標題`,
    h.new_comments AS `新增推文`,
    v.push AS `推`,
    v.boo AS `噓`,
    if(v.push + v.boo >= 10, round(v.boo / (v.push + v.boo), 2), NULL) AS `爭議度`,
    multiIf(s.post_id = '', '', s.score < toFloat64OrDefault('$min_score', 0.5), '不確定', s.polarity = 'negative', '負面', s.polarity = 'neutral', '中立', s.polarity = 'positive', '正面', '') AS `情緒`,
    if(startsWith(p.url, 'https://www.ptt.cc/'), p.url, '') AS url
FROM
(
    SELECT post_id, board, count() AS new_comments
    FROM comments_latest FINAL
    WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND $__timeFilter_ms(commented_at) AND board IN ($board)
    GROUP BY post_id, board
    ORDER BY new_comments DESC
    LIMIT 20
) AS h
LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, title, url FROM posts_latest FINAL WHERE post_id IN (SELECT post_id FROM comments_latest WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND $__timeFilter_ms(commented_at) AND board IN ($board))) AS p ON h.post_id = p.post_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM post_votes WHERE post_id IN (SELECT post_id FROM comments_latest WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND $__timeFilter_ms(commented_at) AND board IN ($board))) AS v ON h.post_id = v.post_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM post_sentiment_latest WHERE post_id IN (SELECT post_id FROM comments_latest WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND $__timeFilter_ms(commented_at) AND board IN ($board))) AS s ON h.post_id = s.post_id
ORDER BY h.new_comments DESC

SELECT
    a.created_at AS `時間`,
    ifNull(a.board, '') AS `看板`,
    a.unit_type AS `單位`,
    if(a.unit_type = 'post', ifNull(nullIf(p.title, ''), a.unit_key), a.unit_key) AS `標題`,
    a.value AS `推文數`,
    round(a.value / greatest(a.baseline, 1), 2) AS `倍數`,
    round(a.zscore, 2) AS `z-score`,
    if(a.unit_type = 'post' AND startsWith(p.url, 'https://www.ptt.cc/'), p.url, '') AS url
FROM (SELECT * FROM alerts WHERE created_at >= now64(6) - INTERVAL 24 HOUR ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) AS a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, title, url FROM posts_latest FINAL WHERE post_id IN (SELECT unit_key FROM alerts WHERE unit_type = 'post' AND created_at >= now64(6) - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) AS p ON a.unit_key = p.post_id
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
